sourcePalette: CHART-A01 (values imported exactly; no new palette introduced)
purpose: Data-driven laboratory biomarker composition, not medical assessment or static plotted asset

source-interval.label: Source laboratory interval
source-interval.description: Source-specific lower and upper limits, applicable to the selected assay and specimen.

selected-only.label: Selected record only
selected-only.description: The selected observation has a known interval; no interval is inferred for other records.

alternate-method.label: Different laboratory method
alternate-method.description: Method A and method B have different reference contexts; not a single universal band.

published-comparison.label: Published comparison
published-comparison.description: Research comparison displayed separately from the reporting laboratory interval.

non-comparable.label: Non-comparable assays
non-comparable.description: A method change interrupts the comparison; segments must remain disconnected.

unavailable.label: Interval unavailable
unavailable.description: No verified source interval: do not draw a band or infer normality.

decision-threshold.label: Decision threshold
decision-threshold.description: A source-qualified clinical decision limit is a line, not a laboratory reference band.

method-changing.label: Reference context changes
method-changing.description: Records carry their own applicable intervals. Do not paint one interval across both groups.

mustNotInfer: normal or healthy from missing interval
a historical interval from a selected record
a continuous trend across non-comparable methods
an unseen measurement or zero from missingness
clinical meaning solely from an outlier
patient values from sample vector specimens
sourceDrawers: Source-linked exact original values, dates, recorded units, assay, limits and method plus revision provenance; no withdrawn source data
accessibility: 44x44 control targets, chart description and exact-value table, keyboard selection/focus return, source panel legibility
